exposure: Norepinephrine infusion combined with crystalloid coload
Norepinephrine infusion combined with colloid coload
outcome: Non-occurrence of hypotension (defined as SBP less than 80% of baseline)
cohort: The study included 200 parturients undergoing spinal anesthesia for cesarean delivery.
finding: Colloid coload (10 mL/kg) reduced the dose of prophylactic norepinephrine infusion by approximately 30% compared with crystalloid coload in parturients undergoing spinal anesthesia for cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: 10 mL/kg colloid coload reduced the dose of prophylactic norepinephrine infusion by approximately 30% during spinal anesthesia for cesarean delivery compared with crystalloid coload.
